{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue_numeric'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Identify rows with conversion errors
conversion_errors = sales_df[sales_df['revenue_numeric'].isna()]

# Drop rows with invalid revenue values
sales_df_clean = sales_df.dropna(subset=['revenue_numeric'])

# Filter for completed orders
completed_orders = sales_df_clean[sales_df_clean['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute mean revenue for completed orders
mean_revenue = completed_orders['revenue_numeric'].mean()

# Print the number of completed orders after cleaning and the mean revenue
print("Number of completed orders after cleaning:", len(completed_orders))
print("Mean revenue of completed orders:", mean_revenue)"}
